observation.command:
echo "=== Token for testuser direct access grant ==="; TOKEN=$(curl -s -X POST http://localhost:8080/realms/my-realm/protocol/openid-connect/token -d "grant_type=password&client_id=strassennamen&username=testuser&password=Test1234!" ); echo "$TOKEN" | head -c 400; echo
echo "=== decode roles ==="
python3 - <<'EOF'
import json,base64,subprocess
out=subprocess.run(["curl","-s","-X","POST","http://localhost:8080/realms/my-realm/protocol/openid-connect/token","-d","grant_type=password&client_id=strassennamen&username=testuser&password=Test1234!"],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout
try:
    t=json.loads(out)
    at=t["access_token"]
    p=at.split('.')[1]; p+='='*(-len(p)%4)
    claims=json.loads(base64.urlsafe_b64decode(p))
    print("resource_access:",json.dumps(claims.get("resource_access")))
    print("preferred_username:",claims.get("preferred_username"))
    open('/tmp/token.txt','w').write(at)
except Exception as e:
    print("ERR",e,out[:500])
EOF
echo "=== call /api/strasse with token ==="
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "HTTP %{http_code}\n" -H "Authorization: Bearer $(cat /tmp/token.txt)" http://localhost:5000/api/strasse
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $(cat /tmp/token.txt)" http://localhost:5000/api/strasse | head -c 500
